text.text_excerpt: I'm not gonna lie- when I heard that Master P was opening a burger place, I had my doubts. I thought it was all a gimmick, so I had to head over and check it out for myself. After much anticipation, I headed to Big Poppa's for lunch. I was on a mission to discover if the burgers here were indeed, "Bout It Bout It". Walking in, I immediately loved the vibe of the place; it's like an old diner with a modern feel and I was given a friendly greeting by the smiling staff. The combination of counter and table service here is like many burger joints. You order your food at the counter, the staff gives you a number brings your order right to your table. I thought I knew for sure what I was gettin...

I saw the recommendation for this place in a Facebook group called "Where NOLA Eats". I ordered the cheeseburger and I have to say it was one of the best hamburgers I have ever eaten. It was so big and juicy, I could have made 2 meals out of it...I will definitely go back here. When I went, you had to walk up and order through a window and then take your food home. I was perfectly fine with that.

Pretty good burger joint. I try to get in all around town. I really enjoy getting out in the city and exploring locally owned businesses. The salmon burger was pretty good but the chicken sandwich was fantastic. My friend ordered the beef burger and she said it was amazing. Be prepared to wait in a line, it is a relatively new establishment. Tell Master P I said hi and ughhhh..nah nah nah nah!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
